title: tab/cdp
description: Shell-to-engine notification: one Chrome DevTools Protocol message for the tab's DevTools agent (CefBrowserHost::SendDevToolsMessage). `message` is the CDP command object as on a DevTools websocket: `{id, method, params}`; the tab is the page target, so there is no sessionId. The answer and the events arrive as tab/cdpEvent.

tab.description: The tab's id, as tab/create answered it ("1", "2", ...; never reused in one engine process).
